body:
Closed as not planned by the maintainer's ruling (2026-08-20 live chat, verbatim: 「10127 关闭，10126 现在就派发执行」), after the cost question 「10127 每天晚上都要运行吗？会不会浪费」. Rationale on record: the merge queue itself already runs the full suite continuously, so a nightly rehearsal adds little detection latency benefit; tonight's incident expressed within 2h of the defect landing — before any nightly would have run. The incident's real lessons are carried by #10126 (the gate, now dispatched) and #10128 (queue-triage bot upgrades). If a scheduled-run need re-emerges (e.g. as a flake census), file a fresh card rather than reopening this one.
